paths.react-dom: @openview/core must stay isomorphic (AGENTS.md 2): no UI dependency.

paths.@openview/designer: core is the root of the dependency graph and must never import a sibling package.
paths.@openview/engine: core is the root of the dependency graph and must never import a sibling package.
paths.@openview/viewer: core is the root of the dependency graph and must never import a sibling package.

paths.react: @openview/engine is a Node service (AGENTS.md 2): no UI dependency.
paths.react-dom: @openview/engine is a Node service (AGENTS.md 2): no UI dependency.
paths.puppeteer: Puppeteer bundles Chromium (~150-300 MB). It belongs in its own adapter package behind the RenderPort, so integrators who only need HTML never download it.
paths.playwright: Playwright bundles browsers. It belongs in its own adapter package behind the RenderPort, so integrators who only need HTML never download it.
paths.@openview/designer: the engine must not depend on the UI layer.
paths.@openview/viewer: the engine must not depend on the UI layer.

paths.puppeteer: browser packages must not pull the render backend into the bundle.
paths.playwright: browser packages must not pull the render backend into the bundle.
paths.@openview/engine: the UI must reach the engine through a port, never by importing it (Hexagonal). Importing it ships Chromium to the browser bundle.
